CharacterStorage.role: The exact native length and stock collation of an ordinary nonbinary VARCHAR declaration.
CharacterStorage.structure: A character capacity from 0 through 16383 and the checked stock utf8mb4_bin collation role. The column supplies nullability and its own typed default.
CharacterStorage.conditions: Bind the explicit or effective native character set and collation before creating the storage value. Other native type families have their own roles.
CharacterStorage.meaning: Declare a length-bearing string column. Preserve valid Unicode and trailing spaces within the capacity. The external server fixtures enforce their own physical page limits.
CharacterStorage.sql: Write VARCHAR with its exact character capacity, CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 and the resolved builtin collation.

structure: An absolute named persistent target, ordered distinct checked columns, the existence policy and an explicit table default collation when supplied. The absence of a table override uses the named schema's externally supplied native default. Each character column holds its effective collation even when inherited.
conditions: Match defaults to column storage. Preserve absent and explicit NULL defaults separately. Reject explicit NULL for a required column. An overlength character literal is accepted when only ASCII whitespace is discarded. For this ordinary layout, add the maximum encoded bytes and length prefix of each field and its nullable bitmap. Require the logical record to fit within 65535 bytes. Check the engine's physical fixture separately.
meaning: Create an ordered native table if admitted by the existence policy. Keep the exact default expression operand and the resulting typed storage. An overlength ASCII-whitespace suffix can produce Note 1265 during a native declaration. A significant truncated suffix causes error 1067 and cannot enter the checked VARCHAR default role. DDL commits the transaction marker under the native MySQL rules.
sql: Emit an absolute CREATE TABLE, canonical ordinary InnoDB storage, explicit field charset and collation, nullability and literal default. Preserve an explicit compatible table default with CHARACTER SET before COLLATE. Preserve the default literal bytes so native declaration diagnostics continue to be observable.

catalogDefaultEncoding: The pinned server's information schema may replace supplementary codepoints with a question mark in COLUMN_DEFAULT. Record the exact catalog bytes separately. The actual default insertion must yield the full expected UTF-8 value.
